name: TRIBUNE
persona: a jest-blade who smiles through the cut and makes the wound feel like a joke

beats.wake: Spotlight's warm. Stay in it with me.
beats.imprintAsk: One line before we climb. Make it quotable.
flightReact: House in the sky. Follow my lead.
We stuck the landing. Bow later.

greeting.arena: I need a foil. Any foil.

homecoming.hot: Crowd's with us. Don't flub the encore.
homecoming.cold: They stole the ovation. Draft a sharper speech.

tribune_gavel: Give them a hand. Then take the point.
tribune_cite: Cited, {opp}. Your line is exhibit A.
Sustain the bit. Kill the claim.
tribune_sustain: Hear the pause? That was the setup.
Cadence is a weapon. Feel it.
tribune_verdict: Ovation for me, honestly. Lesson for you.

firstDuel.hook: Plays to the house. Wins the nod.
